Sam (sec): quick alert - staging smoke failed at image-sign step. cosign returned a KMS permission error. Posting here for infra/runtime to triage.
Yara (eng-infra): looking now. We rolled an IAM tighten last night; might have cut a helper binding used by the builder.
Ben (eng-runtime): can you paste the client error?
Sam (sec): ```cosign: upload failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = missing permission cloudkms.cryptoKeys.encrypt```
kms-watcher: [automated] 2 KMS_DENIED events for key projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/repo/cryptoKeys/staging-sign at 1755555520. Callers: staging-builder-sa and smoke-runner.
Yara (eng-infra): audit diff shows the PR removed serviceAccount:staging-builder-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com from the key binding. I'll re-add a key-scoped encrypter role immediately and annotate it as "temp:staging-unblock".
Alicia (sre): prefer scoped restore + a short TTL note in PR so compliance has record. Also open an incident channel for follow-up.
Ben (eng-runtime): while you reapply please don't give project-level roles. We'll gate staging propagation with a runtime guard that rejects unsigned images.
Yara (eng-infra): applied binding at 1755555605, left PR note: "temporary scoped grant to restore staging signing; follow-up to automate ephemeral grants."
kms-watcher: [automated] IAM delta recorded and forwarded to SIEM at 1755555640.
Ben (eng-runtime): retried smoke job -> `cosign: signature upload OK`. Runtime flagged image as signed.
Sam (sec): follow-ups: 1) add a CI preflight to verify key binding before attempting sign (small script that queries key IAM and fails fast), 2) add a safety check to rotation tooling to skip pruning bindings that match builder principals unless explicitly approved, 3) create a ticket for ephemeral grant automation (short-lived access), 4) add alert rule: >1 KMS_DENIED in 15m -> post to #eng-security.
Yara (eng-infra): I'll open PR for the preflight script and update the rotation tool to run a dry-check.
Alicia (sre): I'll create the incident channel `#inc-staging-signing` and add the runbook checklist + link to PRs.
Sam (sec): tagging compliance for retention of the IAM delta and KMS denies. No customer impact. Close once PRs merged and automation ticket created. :white_check_mark:
